description: This Java class 'CreditAllocationsJsonParser' parses JSON data related to credit allocations in loan products, including validation and extraction of allocation rules and transaction types.

classes.name: CreditAllocationsJsonParser
classes.description: A service class responsible for parsing and validating credit allocation rules from JSON commands in loan product configurations.

methods.name: assembleLoanProductCreditAllocationRules
methods.description: Parses JSON command to assemble a list of loan product credit allocation rules, validating them with the validator.

methods.name: populateCreditAllocationRules
methods.description: Populates credit allocation rules from JSON map into a LoanProductCreditAllocationRule object.

methods.name: populateTransactionType
methods.description: Sets the transaction type in the credit allocation rule based on JSON data.

methods.name: getAllocationTypes
methods.description: Extracts and sorts allocation types from a JSON array, validating the order and types.

methods.name: asIntegerOrNull
methods.description: Converts a JSON element to Integer if not null.

methods.name: asStringOrNull
methods.description: Converts a JSON element to String if not null.

methods.name: asJsonArrayOrNull
methods.description: Converts a JSON element to JsonArray if not null.
